For Applicant : Mr. T.R. Patel, Advocate.
For Respondent/State : Mr.Swajeet Singh Ubweja, Pl.
S.B.:Hon'ble Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board 11/06/2024
1.
This is second bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail to him.
First bail application bearing MCRC No.845 of 2024 was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 20.02.2024 with liberty to repeat the prayer after examination of victim.

2. Applicant is in custody in connection with Crime No.452/2023 registered at Police Station Pali,
District-Korba(C.G.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(D)/ 34 of IPC and Sections 4, 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that on 07.03.2023 at about 7:00 p.m. when the victim, aged about 15 years, was returning her home after doing domestic work in the house of one Santoshi, and reached near Depot turn, the accused persons forcibly took hr to Darrakhancha and there co-accused Rajveer committed rape with her.
Report of incident was lodged by victim in concerned police station on the basis of which aforementioned crime was registered and applicant was arrested on 25.12.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that applicant is innocent, he has not committed any offence as alleged and he has been falsely ilmplicated in instant crime.

After withdrawal of first bail application, victim has been examined before the trial Court and from the deposition of victim,
it is reflecting that applicant has been falsely implicated only because brother and father of victim were arrested iin connection with the report lodged by applicant and co- accused Sunil Yadav with regard to assaults made by them to applicant and said Sunil Yadav.
Applicant is in jail since 25.12.2023, hence, he may be enlarged on regular bail.

5. Learned counsel for the State opposes submissions of learned counsel for applicant and submits that allegation against the applicant is of gang rape and even the victim in her Court statement stuck to the allegation of rape levelled by her in FIR.
6. Pursuant to notice issued by this Court, victim appeared before this Court on 10.06.2024 and raised objection in grant of bail to the applicant.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

8. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of case, nature of allegations and the documents filed along with bail application, I do not find present to be a fit case where application of applicant for grant of regular bail should be allowed and therefore, it is rejected at this stage.
9. Certified copy as per rules. Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
